title: Activity loops
responsibility: Summarizes the loop templates recorded for a project.

inputs.name: ActivityLoops.loops
inputs.description: Required loop summary with total tracked loops and per-template counts, completion/open counts, last-use times and names.

outputs.name: ActivityLoops
outputs.description: Loop-type list with totals, formatted last-use time and loop names. Empty types show that no loop is tracked. Does not create, resume or evaluate loops.
